integrity: Direct local-ring proof; companion exact finite-field checker is supporting evidence, not a proof for all fields. All cited research sources are identified with their proper scope.
scientific_limitations: Only the constant-zero component of first jets of finite simple graph edge ideals without isolated vertices; no primary decomposition of the other components, no higher jets, and no independent originality audit. More general unindexed previous coverage remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Characteristic-sensitive multiplicity of the central component of graph first-jet schemes
